step1.title: Company Establishment
step1.desc: Issuing investment and commercial licenses, issuing the commercial register (CR), and completing legal procedures and government platforms.

step2.title: Market Study
step2.desc: Analyzing the market and competitors, identifying target customers and promising investment opportunities, and selecting the most appropriate location and activity.

step3.title: Feasibility Study
step3.desc: Preparing financial and operational studies, estimating expected costs and revenues, calculating profits, break-even point, and ROI.

step4.title: Business Plan
step4.desc: Preparing an integrated operational plan, building the administrative and operational structure, and defining human resources, suppliers, and procedures.

step5.title: Preparation
step5.desc: Preparing headquarters, technical and operational setups, and preparing work teams and approved systems for launch.

step6.title: Operations
step6.desc: Initiating actual project operations, managing daily operations efficiently, and tracking workflow accurately and professionally.

step7.title: Development & Expansion
step7.desc: Improving operational performance, reducing costs, increasing profitability, and expanding the business base locally and regionally.
